instagram.caption:
The rag pile.
The Utility and Cleaning Zone in the Laundry Room. Hold the tools that keep this room and the strip of floor in front of the machines clean, dry and ready.

What done looks like:
1. Dustpan hanging heads up with painted outlines showing behind each one
2. A single labeled caddy holding every vacuum attachment
3. A mop head that is dry to the touch
4. The bucket sitting inside its taped floor square with nothing stored inside it

Free written steps for this zone, no signup: link in bio, or search 6S Success utility and cleaning zone.
